plugins.name: summarix-telegram
plugins.description: Digest of your Telegram channels inside Claude Code: posts from your own channel list retold with a link to every post, in 13 styles, plus channel search and discovery.

plugins.name: summarix-panel
plugins.description: Your Telegram channel digest in a pane beside the chat: every point linked to its post, earlier digests a click away, a new one in one press. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.
